pain-mech.text: Pain receptors in the skin send signals to the spinal cord.
Local anesthetics block the transmission of pain signals along nerves.
Morphine dampens pain signals before they reach the brain.

touch-temp.text: Nerve endings in the skin respond to pressure.
The fingertips are highly sensitive to touch and temperature.
Light touch and vibration are sensed by different receptors in the skin.

withdrawal.text: She flinched and pulled her hand away from the flame.
She yanked her hand back the moment she touched the hot iron.
She drew back in surprise when the door burst open.

flip.alone: She flinched and pulled her hand away.
flip.flipped: She smiled and pulled her hand away.
